mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 4% over the prior 3 months reduces the discount rate applied to future corporate cash flows, lowering the present value of expected earnings and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns in the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by at least 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during high-rate periods (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which raises consumer confidence and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 10,000 jobs while UNRATE falls by at least 0.5 percentage points within the same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative despite the labor indicators meeting the trigger, or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE and SPX 60d returns is <0.3 in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (not directly observable in the given catalog but proxy via HOUST for industrial demand) combined with a decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a shift toward demand-led growth, which supports equity valuations and produces positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases for two consecutive months while CPIAUCSL decreases by at least 0.2% in the same period
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative when the trigger is met, or the p-value for the regression of SPX 20d returns on HOUST/CPIAUCSL is >0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in manufacturing production (INDPRO) below trend suggests supply-side constraints that raise input costs and slow corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly different from zero during INDPRO contractions (p > 0.05), or INDPRO returns to trend within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the increased risk aversion among global investors reduces equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive during high-rate periods when the trigger is met (contradicting the mechanism), or the effect size is smaller than the 95% confidence interval.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% without a corresponding rise in labor force participation (not directly observable) suggests a tight labor market that can drive wage inflation, pressuring equities and producing negative 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4% in a single month
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4%, or the p-value for SPX 60d returns regressed on UNRATE is >0.1.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer price indices (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2% indicate accelerating inflation, which erodes real equity returns and is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by at least 2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive during periods of high CPIAUCSL growth (contradicting the mechanism), or the effect is smaller than the 99% confidence interval.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls for three consecutive months below its 12-month moving average, it signals a supply-side recession that reduces corporate order backlogs and depresses equity valuations, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate economic recovery.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases for three consecutive months below its 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns remain negative despite the three-month INDPRO contraction pattern, or the pattern reverses before 60 days.
